answer: The protocol enforces exclusivity by mandating 3,000 megabytes of memory-hard work per node to gate access. A verifier maps each agent to a unique dune of volatile RAM, creating a fable of isolation where concurrent tasks trigger an instant memory fault. If an honest node pays for one unit of cost, 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times that cost, as each occupies a distinct grove of addressing that precludes parallel state reuse.
